xml-extension.xml: <!-- Nuxeo OOTB lacks proper WebP support (WebP files are imported as File instead of Picture). Meanwhile the Content Intelligence connector (on which nuxeo-ai-content-intelligence-connector is built) calls it out as a supported format but also lacks the necessary config (cf. https://hyland.atlassian.net/browse/NXCON-347). So we add WebP support for completeness. --> <extension target="org.nuxeo.ecm.platform.mimetype.service.MimetypeRegistryService" point="mimetype"> <mimetype normalized="image/webp" binary="true" iconPath="image.gif"> <mimetypes> <mimetype>image/webp</mimetype> </mimetypes> <extensions> <extension>webp</extension> </extensions> </mimetype> </extension> <extension target="org.nuxeo.ecm.platform.filemanager.service.FileManagerService" point="plugins"> <plugin name="Imageplugin" class="org.nuxeo.ecm.platform.picture.extension.ImagePlugin" order="10" merge="true"> <filter>image/webp</filter> </plugin> </extension>
